settings.body: One formula at a time, in the order they are ready. Nothing goes on sale before the panel on the back of it is final.

settings.title: Repetition over intensity
settings.body: A dose you will actually take every evening beats a stronger one you take twice a week. We formulate for the boring version, because that is the version that works.

settings.title: Show the dose
settings.body: Milligrams, serving size, lot, expiry — printed in full on the front of the pack and again on this page. Nothing sits behind the words proprietary blend.

settings.title: Earn the calm
settings.body: White space is the product. We would rather leave a claim off the pack than crowd one onto it, and we would rather you read the panel than the poetry.
